Card Q&A.a: Yes. An Option card’s [Security] effect is not considered to be the same thing as using an Option card, so it activates normally.
Card Q&A.q: I use this card, then attack my opponent. If an Option card with a [Security] effect is flipped over during the security check, does its effect activate?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. Activating  on an Option card that was already placed in your battle area is not considered to be the same thing as using an Option card, so it activates normally.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent uses this card and passes the turn back to me. Can I activate  on an Option card that was already placed in my battle area?

Effect: [Main] Your opponent can't use Option cards until the end of their next turn.
Security Effect: [Security] Your opponent can't use Option cards this turn. Then, add this card to its owner's hand.
